subject: MAP draft & timeline shift — Stellarnet availability change
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@stellarnet.com>, Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@stellarnet.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-08T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + MAP draft (next steps & info requests)

Hi Sofia and Ethan — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the follow-ups we promised: 

- Outcome from call: confirmation that primary use case is low-latency customer support embeddings and multi-tenant inference for two pilot apps.
- Key risk: procurement timeline tied to exec availability (VP Product currently on leave through May).
- Action items we own: provide a draft Mutual Action Plan (attached), SOC 2 evidence checklist, and an engineering deep-dive agenda.

Attached: stellarnet_mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (draft). It has proposed milestones, owners, dependencies, and a target close of 2027-05-20 based on your comments today.

Please review the MAP and confirm: 1) stakeholders who will own each milestone on your side, 2) any hard dates we should map to (e.g., procurement committee meeting), and 3) availability for a tech deep-dive next week.

Next steps I recommend from our side:
- Mina: update MAP after your feedback and circulate v2.
- Rishi: schedule a 60-min technical session with your infra team; tentative windows noted in the MAP.
- Marissa: prepare a pricing summary and consumption estimate for the pilot.

Thanks — if the VP timeline is likely to push, flag that early so we can re-sequence milestones rather than lose momentum.

Best,

Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: stellarnet_mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@stellarnet.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-09T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + MAP draft (next steps & info requests)

Thanks Mina — good summary. Two quick updates from our side: 

1) VP Product (primary approver) is out through May 15 and has limited bandwidth in the last two weeks of May. That likely shifts our procurement decision to late June.
2) We still want to keep the engineering deep-dive; Ethan and I can do a shorter sync with your infra folks next Tues/Wed.

Can you: 
- Push the target close out to 2027-06-30 as a conservative estimate?
- Highlight which milestones are critical to hit before exec review so we can present progress (eg. pilot integration + performance bench).

We appreciate the MAP — I’ll mark ownership on our side after you send v2.

Sofia Ramos
Director of Platform Engineering
StellarNet
sofia.ramos@stellarnet.com

Date: 2027-04-09T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + MAP draft (next steps & info requests)

Sofia — great, thanks for the color. I’ve attached a revised MAP (v2) that does two things: 1) re-frames milestones into a two-phase plan so we can deliver visible progress before the exec review, and 2) shifts the conservative target close to 2027-06-30 as you requested.

High-level changes in MAP v2 (attached):
- Phase A (by 2027-05-20): pilot integration, performance baseline (P95 latency target defined), and access to a staging dataset. Owner: Redwood (Mina/Rishi) & Stellarnet (Sofia/Ethan).
- Phase B (by 2027-06-30): procurement sign-off, production pilot rollout, and SOC 2 evidence handover. Owner: Stellarnet (procurement + security); Redwood supports evidence compilation.

Dependencies called out explicitly:
- Exec availability for sign-off (Stellarnet) — impacts Phase B timing.
- Staging dataset delivery (StellarNet) — critical for perf bench.
- SOC 2 evidence packet (Redwood to provide checklist; Stellarnet to confirm format).

Requests for your team: please confirm the named owners in the spreadsheet and the one-week windows you’re available for the tech deep-dive (we proposed Apr 13–15 as short blocks). If VP approval is shifted beyond Jun 30, we can re-scope Phase A to include an extended pilot window.

Next internal asks (tagging):
- @Rishi: can you confirm availability for the Apr 13 short infra sync and own the perf bench deliverable?
- @Marissa: I’ll need the two-tier pricing slide (pilot vs. limited production) to share with procurement.
- @Karthik: please note the SOC 2 items we may need to accelerate (see checklist).

Thanks — attaching: stellarnet_mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx, soc2-evidence-checklist.pdf

Best,
Mina

Attachment: stellarnet_mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 140KB); soc2-evidence-checklist.pdf (pdf, 85KB)

Thanks Mina — brief internal alignment and owners confirmed: 

- Rishi (Redwood infra): own perf bench, will run baseline on staging once dataset is available. Available Apr 14 (10–11am) for the short infra sync; provisional on calendar.
- Marissa (Redwood GTM): will produce two-tier pricing deck by Apr 12; will include estimated token consumption and run-rate for pilot vs. limited production.
- Karthik (Redwood Security): will review SOC 2 checklist and assemble evidence bundle we can hand off; ETA for bundle prep: Apr 22.
- Mina: will incorporate all owner notes into MAP v2 and send a final sign-off request to Sofia the week of Apr 19 if Phase A artifacts are on track.

Callout: the staging dataset delivery from StellarNet is the gating item. If that slips, we should consider an alternate perf plan using a synthetic dataset to keep momentum for the exec review.

I’ll update the MAP spreadsheet with the confirmed owners and tentative dates this morning.

-Rishi
